{{Quote|What are those?''"<br />"''Coin-crabs. Reminds me of those happy days we spent frying Yuuzhan Vong.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Goran Beviin]]|<ref name="Bloodlines" />}}
'''Coin-crabs''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Beach/Legends|coastlines]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Known to be tasty when eaten,<ref name="TCSWE" /> [[deep-fried coin-crabs]] were served at the [[Horizon Hotel]] in Taris' [[Upper City]]. In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the veteran [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Goran Beviin]] ordered a bowl of deep-fried [[Coin/Legends|coin]]-[[Crab/Legends|crabs]] while visiting the Horizon [[Hotel/Legends|Hotel]] for a meeting with [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coin-crabs were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy of the Force]]'' novel [[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines|''Bloodlines'']], written by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Karen Traviss]] and published [[August 29]], [[2006]].<ref name="Bloodlines" /> The coin-crab later received a brief informational entry in the [[2008]] reference guide ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', which provided new details on the crab's native habitat.<ref name="TCSWE" />
